# Town of Wardsboro municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Wardsboro Public Library, About page (live): the full seven-name trustee roster includes Martin Loftus and Mark Fernandes alongside the five already recorded. Both seats were warned for election at the March 3, 2026 meeting and both men sit in the trustees' minutes of March 26, 2026 (Loftus re-elected Treasurer). The page states trustees are elected at town meeting, vacant seats may be appointed; no per-person mechanism document was found -- disclosed on issue #163.
